title: GTA 6 haritası GTA 5'in iki katı büyüklüğünde olacak
summary: Rockstar Games'in yeni oyunu Grand Theft Auto VI, GTA 5'ten iki kat büyük haritası ve dinamik hava koşullarıyla geliyor.
body:
Grand Theft Auto VI haritası, önceki oyun GTA 5'in haritasına kıyasla iki kat daha büyük bir alan sunmaya hazırlanıyor. Game Informer'ın aktardığı son bilgilere göre Rockstar Games, yeni oyunun kurgusal Leonida bölgesinde çok daha kapsamlı ve dinamik bir harita deneyimi yaratmayı hedefliyor.

## Gelişmiş hava durumu ve kasırgalar

Rockstar Games açıklamalarına göre Leonida bölgesinde hava koşulları tamamen yerelleştirilmiş ve zamana yayılmış bir yapıya kavuşuyor. Oyuncular haritanın bir noktasında masmaviyken hemen kısa bir mesafede şiddetli yağmurla karşılaşabilecek. Kasırgalar ve tropikal fırtınalar gibi büyük hava olaylarının yer alacağı sistem; yoğun yağmur, güçlü rüzgarlar ve fırtına bulutlarıyla dikkat çekecek.

## Hayvan çeşitliliği ve aktiviteler

Oyun dünyasında keşfedilmeyi bekleyen detaylar arasında 60 farklı kuş türü ve 30 kara memelisi dahil olmak üzere toplamda 170'ten fazla hayvan türü yer alıyor. Oyuncular ayrıca baz istasyonundan dalışa, sokak yarışlarından kayaya kadar çok sayıda aktiviteye katılabilecek.

**Neden önemli?** Rockstar Games yetkilileri, serinin yeni oyunundaki binaların iç kısımları ve detay seviyesi üzerinde yoğun bir şekilde çalıştıklarını belirterek, yeni dünyanın bugüne kadar hazırladıkları en büyük ve en yoğun yapıyı oluşturduğunu vurguluyor.

source_texts.title: GTA 6 map officially twice as large as GTA 5, features hurricanes and tropical storms
source_texts.summary: Rockstar says GTA 6's map is the biggest map Rockstar has ever created "by some degree"
source_texts.text:
Grant Theft Auto 6âs map is twice the size of GTA 5âs and will feature advanced weather systems like tropical storms and hurricanes.
Thatâs according to a new preview featured in the latest issue of Game Informer, which shares new details on, among other things, GTA 6âs weather systems, which it says will âÂ achieve a sense of scale we haven’t felt beforeâ.
According to Rockstar, Grand Theft Auto VI will feature a more dynamic and localized weather system in Leonida, allowing different areas of the map to experience dramatically different conditions at the same time.
Players may be able to stand beneath clear skies in one part of Leonida while watching heavy rain fall just a short distance away, it says. The system is designed to reflect the unpredictable weather commonly experienced in Florida, where intense rain showers can occur alongside bright sunshine.
“We have re-engineered our weather system to make everything much more localized and persistent, and really wanted the world to feel dynamically solid and achieve a sense of scale we haven’t felt before,” Owen Shepherd, vice president of art for lighting and rendering at Rockstar, told Game Informer.
“The world features new fully dynamic cloudscapes that roll across the map, these give us a broad spectrum of weather from the clear blue skies of a Miami winter to the vertiginous cumulonimbus clouds with sporadic lightning that you see most afternoons in the Floridian summer and autumn.”
Rockstar has not revealed how frequently these major weather events will occur or how they may influence gameplay and the story, but the storms are expected to feature heavy cloud cover, powerful winds, dense atmospheric effects, and intense rainfall.
During severe storms, players can expect to see water pouring from rooftops and lampposts, while thunder and flashes of lightning illuminate the surrounding clouds, creating a more dramatic and immersive weather experience.
According to Rockstar Games‘ head of development/co-studio head Aaron Garbut, Leonida is the biggest map Rockstar has ever created “by some degree”, describing it as twice as large as GTAV, with more detail.
“This new world is different. We obsessed about every part â the rooftops, the alleys, the internals and everything in between to the point we hit a critical mass with the numbers of our interiors, and you start to feel the buildings are more real inside and out. This world is a cohesive whole with the density of content and a hand-crafted quality to every bit.”
According to Rockstar, GTA 6 will feature over 170 animal species, including 60 types of birds, 30 land mammals, and sea creatures such as sharks, whales, and jellyfish.
In terms of activies, the game will include Base jumping, Billiards, Gyms, Kayaking, Mini golf, Scuba diving, Street and off-road racing, Zoos, Air boating, and Jet skiing.
